title: BOM और Manufacturing
intro:
भाग 8 — Manufacturing & Job Work

कुल Problems: 4 │ 🟢 2 🟡 1 🔴 1

🎯 इस Chapter में आप सीखेंगे

Bill of Materials बनाकर Production और Cost निकालना।

🧭 Tally में रास्ता (Steps)

Stock Item → Set Components (BOM)

Stock Journal (Manufacturing) में BOM चुनें

Cost per Unit जाँचें

⚠️ आम गलतियाँ

Wastage/Overhead BOM में न जोड़ना

Raw Material के Rate Update न करना

📌 ज़रूरी नोट

हर Raw Material व Finished Good के लिए ज़रूरी Alternate Units बनाएँ। Stock Item में F12 से Bill of Materials (BOM) Enable करें और Components भरें। 'Manufacturing Journal' नाम का नया Voucher Type (Stock Journal आधारित, Use as Manufacturing Journal=Yes) बनाएँ। Overheads वहीं Additional Cost के रूप में जोड़ें। हर तारीख़ 1st/2nd/Last Date, FY है।

📘 Practice Problems

हर Problem में करना है: Create the Raw Material & Finished Good Stock Items with BOM in Tally Prime, pass the Manufacturing Journal with overheads, and verify the effective cost per unit along with the Sale/Drawings/Loss entries.
guide:
BOM और Manufacturing

हर Problem: क्या करना है → Steps → Entry Table → ✅ Check (उत्तर-कुंजी से मिलान)।

सबसे पहले — BOM और Manufacturing की तैयारी

  • F11 (Features) → Maintain Inventory = Yes और Enable Bill of Materials (BOM) = Yes।
  • Raw Material और Finished Goods के Stock Items बनाएँ (Units/Alternate Unit सहित)।
  • Finished Goods Item में Set Components List (BOM): Name, "Quantity of Finished Good" (जितना एक बैच), और हर Raw Material की Qty।
  • Stock Journal (Alt+F7) में Manufacturing Mode: Production (Finished Goods) में BOM चुनें; Consumption में Raw Materials अपने-आप आ जाएँगे।
  • Overheads/Labour: Stock Journal में Additional Cost के Ledgers (Voucher Type में "Track Additional Cost of Purchase/Manufacture" चालू)।
  • जाँच: Stock Summary में Finished Good का Effective Rate = कुल लागत ÷ Qty।
याद रखें

Cost per Unit = (Material + Overheads + Labour) ÷ उत्पादित Qty।

Wastage/Loss को BOM में जोड़ें (जैसे 5% milling loss → 1.05 Kg Wheat)।

Drawings, Free Sample और Loss में Stock Cost पर निकलता है — Sale Rate पर नहीं।
outro:

problems.q:

  • BOM for 1 Kg Wheat Flour: 1.05 Kg Wheat (5% milling loss)
  • 2nd April — Manufactured 90 Kg Wheat Flour using 94.5 Kg Wheat (Stock Journal — Manufacturing Mode)

problems.title: Chocolate Cake Factory — 9-Ingredient BOM, Overheads, Sale, Drawings  &  Loss (Expert)
problems.q:
🔴 Expert

सभी Items में Alternate Unit 'Grms' भी बनाएँ (1 Kg = 1000 Grms)। Opening — HDFC Bank ₹3,00,000; Cash ₹50,000.

1st April — Purchased all Raw Materials above from Groffers (Invoice INV/GF01, stored in Ashoka Road Godown).

Overheads (% of Material Cost, Additional Cost in Manufacturing Journal): Factory Electricity 15%, Factory Rent 5%, Administrative Expenses 2%, Carriage Expenses 1%.

1st May — Manufactured 50 Pound Chocolate Cake (Stock Journal, Manufacturing Mode); paid Labour Expenses ₹1,000 cash.

2nd May — Sold 20 Pound Chocolate Cake in Cash at 30% Mark-up on Cost.

1st June — Owner took 2 Pound Cake for personal use (Drawings).

1st June — Distributed 1 Pound Cake as a Free Sample (Marketing Expense).

2nd June — 2 Pound Cake destroyed/eaten by pests (Loss of Stock).
